title: 上海高考翻译背诵-89-24一模

items.zh: 室友们商定好每两天打扫一次宿舍。
items.en: Our roommates have agreed to clean the dormitory every two days.

items.zh: “乏味”这个词和他最新的漫画沾不上边。
items.en: The word “dull” doesn’t apply to his latest comic.

items.zh: 说实话，尽管城市漫步广受年轻人欢迎，我还是偏爱海钓。
items.en: To tell the truth, despite city-walking’s wide popularity among young people, I prefer deep-sea fishing.

items.zh: 球员个人是否拥有出色的得分能力固然重要，但场上取胜的关键在于团队合作。
items.en: While an individual player’s excellent ability to score does matter, the key to victory lies in teamwork on the field.
